context_requirements: No annotated molecular targets are listed for this class in the Drug Repurposing Hub, so no transcriptional response can be predicted from mechanism alone.

Class members are heterogeneous (Na+ channel blockers, K+ channel blockers, beta-blockers, Ca2+ channel blockers) and act on ion channels or adrenergic receptors not represented in the 978 landmark genes.
Any observed response would likely reflect off-target cytotoxicity at 10 micromolar rather than a class-specific transcriptional program.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent, class-wide signature across multiple antiarrhythmics in these nine lines would contradict the prediction of no mechanism-specific transcriptional response.
Consistent induction of a specific transcriptional program at 6 h across lines would indicate a direct target not captured by the current target annotation.

evidence.supports: Propafenone, an antiarrhythmic, induces apoptosis and mitochondrial dysfunction in esophageal cancer cells, but this is an off-target anticancer effect rather than a class-specific transcriptional mechanism.
Muscarinic M3 receptor modulation affects cardiac conduction development, but muscarinic receptors are not among the landmark genes and this is not a general antiarrhythmic class mechanism.
